scope.experience: Writing issue detection and accept/dismiss suggestion cards
scope.task: Review an English email for correctness and clarity, inspect suggestion explanations, and accept or dismiss changes.
scope.configuration: Core writing suggestions with manual acceptance, using a plan that exposes the relevant suggestions. No plan or browser installation was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual writing everyday English prose

conversational.rationale: Inline highlights and suggestion cards create a guided review experience; a generative chat capability is not required for this workflow.
conversational.uncertainty: The product's wider chat and agent features are intentionally not scored here.

specialization.rationale: The scoped feature focuses on improving correctness, clarity and style in writing, with specialized feedback controls.
specialization.uncertainty: Writing topics can be general, and language-quality specialization is not domain-expert knowledge.

autonomy.rationale: Suggestions appear automatically as the user writes, but the user normally accepts or dismisses them and retains publication responsibility.
autonomy.uncertainty: Automatic or agent-driven rewriting would be a different configuration.

accessibility.rationale: Embedding suggestions in familiar writing applications supports students and professionals without requiring a separate technical workflow.
accessibility.uncertainty: Premium features, supported environments and language coverage constrain use; no assistive-technology evaluation was performed.

explainability.rationale: Highlighted phrases and Learn more explanations connect proposed changes to concrete writing issues that users can inspect and reject.
explainability.uncertainty: An explanation may still be wrong or context-insensitive; it does not reveal the underlying model's full reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Grammarly inline suggestions with human acceptance, excluding generative chat and agents. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003474732-Grammarly-Editor-user-guide and https://www.grammarly.com/how-grammarly-works .
